crystal_phase.Pt0.5Ru0.5: fcc Pt phase (JCPDS file 04-0802), hcp Ru phase (JCPDS file 06-0663)

Proof in the paper: The lattice fringes of Pt nanoparticles over the Pt/CNT catalyst show the inter-planar spacings of 0.226 and 0.198 nm, which match well with those of the Pt(1 1 1) and Pt(1 0 0) planes, respectively; the lattice fringes of Ru nanoparticles over the Ru/CNT catalyst show the inter-planar spacings of 0.205 and 0.214 nm, which could be ascribed to those of Ru(1 0 1) and Ru(0 0 2) planes, respectively. The bimetallic catalysts exhibit the inter-planar spacings ranging from 0.222 to 0.224 nm as well as from 0.194 to 0.195 nm, which are most likely ascribed to those of the (1 1 1) and (2 0 0) planes of PtRu alloy, respectively.
